name: FOREGRIP
text: When a friendly Kasrkin shoots an enemy within 3 inches, the ranged weapons printed on its datacard (pistols excluded) have Accurate 1.

name: LONG-RANGE SCOPE
text: When a friendly Kasrkin shoots an enemy more than 6 inches away and retains any crit, its hot-shot weapons other than the hot-shot laspistol have Saturate for that sequence.

name: RELICS OF CADIA
text: Once per turning point, if a friendly Kasrkin's attack roll (shooting, fighting or retaliating) shows at least two fails, throw one of them away and count another as a normal success.

name: COMBAT DAGGERS
text: Every friendly Kasrkin carries a combat dagger (Atk 3, Hit 4+, Dmg 3/4) for the battle.
